name: Kugahara
tagline: Shinagawa in 29 minutes and Shibuya in 33 minutes. Served by 1 line. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥70,000 to ¥80,000.
summary: The station is in Ota City, served by Tokyu Ikegami Line. Journey times to the main business districts are 46 minutes to Otemachi, 41 minutes to Shinjuku, 33 minutes to Shibuya and 29 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥70,000 to ¥80,000. The station stands 16 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 11.0 m. The land around the station has gentle slopes.

terrain.note: The station sits on the higher side of the ground around it, at 16 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 8.3 m to 19.3 m, a difference of 11.0 m.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls outside the projected inundation area. Even so, 3 of the nine points within 400 m fall inside the area, and the deepest projection there is less than 0.5 m. On the whole, the flood projection here is among the smallest in the 23 wards.

medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 18 clinics and 9 pharmacies. Day-to-day care is available close to the station. The nearest hospital is 東京ちどり病院, about 26 minutes' walk from the station. The next nearest is 池田動物病院, about 27 minutes' walk. "Hospital" here means a facility OpenStreetMap records as one. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 1 line serve the station: Tokyu Ikegami Line.
congestion: Tokyu Ikegami Line runs at 130% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch is 大崎広小路→五反田, which this station is not on. At 100%, the ministry's scale describes every passenger either seated or able to hold a strap or pillar. The figures describe each line's busiest stretch, so the stretch you ride may be easier.

rentRange.note: Around this station, One room ¥70,000 to ¥80,000 and 1K ¥90,000 to ¥100,000. 1LDK ¥140,000 to ¥150,000 and 2LDK ¥200,000 to ¥210,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.

rentReason: A one-room flat here goes for ¥70,000 to ¥80,000. Set against how long it takes to reach the central business districts, that is about average for the 23 wards. schools and parks within walking distance and quiet surroundings pushes the figure up. On the other side, only one line, the {line}, serving the station holds it down. For 2LDK, though, the sources differ by ¥30,000 or more. They count different sets of properties, so read those figures as a range rather than a point.

neighbours.lead: For how close the centre is, Unoki; for how little of the area is in the flood projection, Kugahara.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to from Kugahara. Unoki has the Tokyu Tamagawa Line, a different set from Kugahara. To Shibuya, for instance, Unoki is 4 minutes quicker. On how little of the area is in the flood projection, Kugahara comes out ahead.

neighbours.lead: Ontakesan is ahead on how little of the area is in the flood projection, and little else separates the two.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to from Kugahara. It is served by the same lines as Kugahara. Journey times to the main business districts are much the same. On how little of the area is in the flood projection, Ontakesan comes out ahead.

leads.terrain: There are gentle slopes around the station, and which block you live on changes how much effort getting about takes.
leads.groceries: There are 5 supermarkets within walking distance, and the nearest is 2 minutes on foot.
leads.hazards: The station itself is outside the projected flood area, but blocks nearby are inside it.
leads.stationNote: Only the Tokyu Ikegami Line serves this station, so when it stops you walk to another station.
leads.rentRange: The balance between commuting time and rent is about average for the 23 wards.
leads.medical: The number of clinics and pharmacies within walking distance is on the high side for the 23 wards.
leads.congestion: Among the 23 wards' stations, the lines here are lightly loaded in the morning.
leads.noiseSources: Whether a flat faces the road changes what you hear indoors.
